verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own IAM docs describe fine-grained permissions and resource-level scoping: they control who can do what on which resource. The pack contains no evidence of IAM conditions or of documented policy-evaluation semantics, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: IAM conditions (conditional bindings), documented policy evaluation/inheritance logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, least privilege is expressible — fine-grained IAM policies with conditions, resource-level scoping, and documented policy evaluation

citations.quote: IAM memungkinkan Anda mengontrol _siapa_ yang dapat melakukan _apa_ pada _resource mana_.
IAM est un outil permettant de gérer les autorisations précises pour Google Cloud.
